name: KPK USDC RWA Liquidity
description: The KPK USDC RWA Liquidity vault earns a liquidity premium by market-making tokenised RWA collateral: buying at a discount when holders need immediate liquidity, and redeeming at par with the issuer. Idle capital is allocated to USDC lending strategies, including KPK-curated Morpho vaults, so capital remains continuously yielding. RWA exposure is capped per market, with 24/7 risk management automation.
